integrity: Exact coboundary and symbolic center reduction; finite rational checks and numerical diagnostics supplement but do not prove all-dimension statements. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Real m>=3, 0<b<1; critical logarithmic law applies only to bounded orbits outside the strong-stable set; no statement about noncritical chaos or critical unbounded trajectories. Full Richter 2002 text unavailable, so priority remains provisional.
title: Global recurrence threshold and logarithmic fold relaxation for generalized Hénon maps
